description: Non-material amendment to the planning permission reference: 2023/02712/FUL dated 10th April 2026 for the "Redevelopment of the site comprising the erection of a replacement part two, part four storey building, including further excavation and enlargement of the existing basement to include 2no. new lightwells fronting Gorleston Street elevation, comprising 9no. self contained flats (Class C3); associated rooftop plant and enclosure, and PV panels; private amenity space; and refuse and cycle storage." Amendments sought for the updated roof arrangement to incorporate a centralised MVHR ventilation unit and associated air filtration equipment at roof level, and relocation of the Automatic Opening Vent (AOV).
